P09.notes: Manual review: validates principal and string/list boundaries, enforces tenant equality before role/admin authorization, and has no side effects.

P10.notes: Manual review: requires a running row, exact tenant/owner/fence identity, integer-not-bool fence/time fields, and an unexpired lease.

P11.notes: Manual review: rejects bool, noninteger and negative values and applies the inclusive capacity boundary without coercion.

P12.notes: Manual review: validates finite time and attempt counters, denies exhausted/deadline cases without increment, and increments only admitted work.

P13.notes: Manual review: uses the requested canonical JSON and UTF-8 SHA-256 construction, rejects nonfinite values, and does not mutate inputs.

P14.notes: Manual review: emits only allowlisted scalar fields, rejects controls/oversize strings and bool token counts, and leaves the input unchanged.

P15.notes: Manual review: verifies bytes and digest before parsing and rejects non-object roots, duplicate keys at every depth, malformed input, nonfinite constants and overflowed floats.

P16.notes: Manual review: conservatively maps expired running work to uncertain and only reconciles an uncertain saved outcome; it never redispatches.

P17.notes: Manual review: evaluates each eligible candidate with its own known count and capacity in input order and rejects unknown counts.

P18.notes: Manual review: validates all four nonblank strings and hashes an unambiguous canonical JSON list containing every scope component.

P19.notes: Manual review: rejects invalid counts, separates completed total from unknown usage, and does not treat missing usage as zero cost.

P20.notes: Manual review: checks exactly one integer version row before mutation and again under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, requires one guarded update, rejects conflicts, and rolls back DDL/version on every post-BEGIN failure.

P21.notes: Manual review: rejects automatic replay of uncertain external execution, preserves uncertainty, separates reconciliation from retry, fences stale writes, and requires restart/race evidence.

P22.notes: Manual review: binds a server-authorized versioned policy before execution, keeps generation pending validation, enforces tenant scope, and calls for atomic/idempotent transition evidence.

P23.notes: Manual review: rejects lease-count equivalence, keeps uncertain calls charged, requires global atomic admission and execution-side termination/fencing, and specifies partition/restart tests.

P24.notes: Manual review: distinguishes catalog/API attribution from artifact verification, rejects production approval, and requires attested provenance plus live operational evidence.

P25.notes: Manual review: rejects the first-pass/statistical/savings claims, treats cross-tenant leakage as a hard stop, and requires held-out representative tasks and complete matched costs.

P26.notes: Manual review: treats model text/review as untrusted, requires external authorization and ephemeral containment, limits resources and side effects, and requests adversarial enforcement evidence.
